review.note: A7: the span was 1946-1989, the First Indochina War's opening and the Cambodian-Vietnamese War's close. The cited article's first sentence says, at the cached revision 1373921212, "waged in Indochina from 1945 to 1991". This is an umbrella: widening it widens what may be filed under it and argues nothing.

title: Indochina Wars
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Indochina wars", at revision 1373921212, opens: "During the aftermath of World War II and the Cold War, the Indochina wars were a series of wars which were waged in Indochina from 1945 to 1991, by communist forces against the opponents. The term "Indochina" referred to former French Indochina, which included the current states of Vietnam, Laos, and Cambodia. In current usage, it applies largely to a geographic region, rather than to a political area." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2342102, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "series of wars fought in Southeast Asia from 1946 until 1991". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
